candidateFindings.title: Transient PASS sourceId grammar is wider than mandatory M3.3 handoff grammar
candidateFindings.problem: transient_source_admission.SOURCE_ID accepts ':' and emits PASS_TRANSIENT_SOURCE_ADMISSION_V1 for sourceId='user:private-course', while handoff.parse_bindings delegates to factory.SOURCE_ID, which rejects ':' and raises HandoffInputError before prepare-review can transport the admitted source.
candidateFindings.impact: A policy-valid user-provided private source can receive an admission PASS that is unusable at the very M3.3 handoff boundary this work package extends. The PASS therefore overstates admissibility across the required workflow and creates a deterministic false operational PASS.
deterministicReproduction: Create a valid transient declaration with sourceId='user:private-course', version='qa-v1' and all required private/transient policy fields.
Call transient_source_admission.build_admission on readable source bytes: verdict is PASS_TRANSIENT_SOURCE_ADMISSION_V1.
Pass the same sourceId, source bytes and admission to handoff.prepare_review_bundle.
M3.3 fails with HandoffInputError: invalid sourceId 'user:private-course'.
candidateFindings.observedOracle: 24 tests executed; 23 PASS and exactly 1 FAIL, QA-WP-025-F01.

nonGoals: Repairing transient_source_admission.py, handoff.py or any product path.

The oracle is authored from the public contract and implementation surface and adds attacks beyond product regression tests.
A PASS is valid only on fresh exact-head Actions evidence; any reproducible product defect forces HOLD_QA_WP_025_EXACT_HEAD_CONTRADICTORY_QA.
